patch.value: GH-708: make retained delete tombstones discoverable and policy-controlled

Expose history streams retained after pm delete as intentional tombstones through supported health/list output, explain retention in delete results/help, and define explicit opt-in retention or garbage-collection policy without weakening append-only audit defaults.

pm health or an equivalent supported command reports a bounded count/list of history streams without live item files and distinguishes valid delete tombstones from corruption; pm delete output and help explicitly state that the history stream is retained; an opt-in tombstone retention or gc policy is documented and cannot silently remove append-only proof; SDK/CLI contracts expose the same structured tombstone state; sandboxed delete, health, history, gc, and merge regression tests preserve 100% coverage
Deleted-item audit streams are visible, explainable, and bounded by an explicit retention policy
Agents can distinguish intentional audit proof from orphaned residue and can manage long-lived multi-agent workspace growth without raw filesystem inspection
